elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, etc.)
sub_elements.evidence: doi: 10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; id: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5
sub_elements.quality_note: Properly formatted persistent DOI serving as both id and doi; cell-line RRIDs (CVCL_0419, CVCL_B5P3) also present

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Cell Maps for Artificial Intelligence (CM4AI); description: multi-sentence >1000 char overview of mission, modalities (IF, AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPR), MuSIC pipeline, and RO-Crate/FAIRSCAPE packaging
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear title and comprehensive, purpose-rich description well beyond 200 chars

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [Cell Maps, AI-Ready Data, Bridge2AI, Functional Genomics, Protein-Protein Interactions, Spatial Proteomics, CRISPR Perturbation, ... 25 total]
sub_elements.quality_note: 25 relevant keywords spanning domain, cell lines, methods, and standards

sub_elements.name: Dataset Landing Page or Platform URL
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://www.cm4ai.org; download_url: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5
sub_elements.quality_note: Active project portal plus resolvable DOI landing page

sub_elements.name: Associated Project or Program
sub_elements.evidence: description: 'CM4AI is the Functional Genomics Data Generation Project in the ... Bridge to Artificial Intelligence (Bridge2AI) program'; keywords include Bridge2AI
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear association with NIH Bridge2AI program and CM4AI project

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Mechanism Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms describes open CC BY-NC-SA reuse; distribution_formats and distributions specify access via resolvable DOIs, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, NDEx, and UVA Dataverse; Data Access Committee supervises distribution
sub_elements.quality_note: Access mechanism clearly stated across multiple repositories with governance oversight

sub_elements.name: Data Use Agreement Required?
sub_elements.evidence: KOLF2.1J 'available ... via a simple MTA'; commercial use 'requires separate license negotiation'; Data Access Committee (led by Jillian Parker) supervises distribution and potential dual licensing
sub_elements.quality_note: Terms of use spelled out: open non-commercial reuse under CC license, MTA for one cell line, negotiation for commercial use

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: download_url: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; distributions include path: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5, .../B35XWX, .../F3TD5R, .../K7TGEM
sub_elements.quality_note: Direct resolvable download links for the primary package and each versioned release

sub_elements.name: File Formats Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distributions: format: ZIP, media_type: application/zip; RO-Crate packages with JSON-LD metadata (ro-crate-metadata.json)
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific container and metadata formats named (ZIP, RO-Crate, JSON-LD)

sub_elements.name: External Links to Similar or Related Datasets
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: 13 entries including UVA Dataverse, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, NDEx, Nature/bioRxiv publications, FAIRSCAPE, IMP, CFDE
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich set of links to related repositories, tools, and publications

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; license_and_use_terms: 'Data licensed for reuse under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International license'
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit standard license with clear reuse and attribution conditions

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized
sub_elements.evidence: RO-Crate packages, JSON-LD (Schema.org, EVI), deposits in MassIVE/PRIDE, NCBI SRA, NDEx (Cytoscape/ndex2)
sub_elements.quality_note: Community-standard formats and repositories throughout

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: conforms_to: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema/core-schema; cleaning_strategies map to GO, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, Schema.org, EVI, NCI Thesaurus, BioAssay Ontology, Cell Ontology, CHEBI, EFO
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit schema conformance plus mapping to multiple public ontologies

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Defined for Linking
sub_elements.evidence: FAIRSCAPE assigns persistent resolvable ARK identifiers; DOIs per release; RRIDs CVCL_0419 and CVCL_B5P3 for cell lines
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple persistent linking identifiers (ARK, DOI, RRID) defined

sub_elements.name: Documentation of Processing Tools for Reproducibility
sub_elements.evidence: MuSIC pipeline, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, node2vec, Human Protein Atlas DL model, Cytoscape, Integrative Modeling Platform (IMP) v2.18, Python Modeling Interface; code at fairscape.github.io and integrativemodeling.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Named tools with versions and repository/documentation pointers

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: Dedicated Ethics Module (leaders Bélisle-Pipon, Ravitsky), Data Governance Committee; is_deidentified: 'De-identification confirmed by CM4AI Ethics Module and Data Access Committee'; tasks:4 Value-Sensitive Design and CM4AI Life Cycle framework
sub_elements.quality_note: Ethics oversight documented with named module leaders and governance committee; formal IRB not applicable (non-human-subjects cell-line data)

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified: 'derived from commercially available, de-identified human cell lines (MDA-MB-468 from ATCC; KOLF2.1J from HipSci). Data cannot be matched to individual human subjects with current knowledge'
sub_elements.quality_note: De-identification basis clearly explained, though it is source-inherited rather than an applied technique like Safe Harbor

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Removed or Masked
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements notes donor age/sex/race metadata is retained; no list of specific identifiers removed or masked is provided
sub_elements.quality_note: No enumeration of removed/masked identifiers (largely N/A for de-identified cell lines, but not documented)

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: No collection_process.consent field; cell lines described as 'ethically sourced' but no participant consent procedure or type is stated
sub_elements.quality_note: Consent procedures not described (cell-line provenance implies upstream consent but it is not documented here)

sub_elements.name: Ethical Sourcing Statement Included
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research: 'Both cell lines (MDA-MB-468 and KOLF2.1J) are commercially available, ethically sourced, de-identified cell lines'; Ethics Module and Value-Sensitive Design methodologies (tasks:4)
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit ethical sourcing statement plus ethical-AI governance framework

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Population Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances describe MDA-MB-468 (triple negative breast cancer, RRID:CVCL_0419) and KOLF2.1J iPSC (RRID:CVCL_B5P3), plus 100 chromatin regulators and 100 metabolic enzymes; 7 subpopulations enumerated
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed characterization of cell lines, molecular targets, and treatment/differentiation subpopulations

sub_elements.name: Number of Participants or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: '17 genes endogenously tagged ... 34 additional in process', 'SEC-MS identified 72/100 chromatin modifiers', 'over 1,000 protein complexes', 'genome-scale screens ... for 11,739 targeted genes'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific sample/target counts reported across modalities

sub_elements.name: Modalities or Data Types Listed
sub_elements.evidence: collection_mechanisms and acquisition_methods: immunofluorescence spatial proteomics, AP-MS, SEC-MS, single-cell CRISPR perturbation (scRNA-seq)
sub_elements.quality_note: All four data modalities clearly listed and described

sub_elements.name: Conditions or Phenotypes Represented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations: MDA-MB-468 untreated/paclitaxel/vorinostat; KOLF2.1J undifferentiated, neurons, NPCs, cardiomyocytes; disease scope: cancer, neuropsychiatric, cardiac disorders
sub_elements.quality_note: Conditions and derived phenotypes explicitly represented

sub_elements.name: File Dimensions or Sampling Rates Provided
sub_elements.evidence: Structural details given (4 imaging channels, 6 guide RNAs/gene, 10-layer DAG) but no file dimensions, array sizes, or sampling rates for the distributed files
sub_elements.quality_note: No explicit file-level dimensions, sizes, or sampling rates provided

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking
elements.description: Can a user determine dataset versions, update history, and provenance?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.evidence: version: "2.1"
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit version number present

sub_elements.name: Version History Documented
sub_elements.evidence: updates and distributions list alpha v0.5, March 2025 Beta V1.4, June 2025 Beta V2.1, October 2025 Beta with distinct DOIs (B35XWX, F3TD5R, K7TGEM)
sub_elements.quality_note: Multi-release version history documented with dated releases

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions for Each Version
sub_elements.evidence: distributions:2 'includes perturb-seq in KOLF2.1J iPSCs, SEC-MS in iPSCs ...'; :3 'adds RGB IF images, RO-Crate metadata corrections, naming convention changes, and SEC-MS for MDA-MB-468'; :4 'adds Perturb-seq for MDA-MB-468'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific per-release change descriptions provided

sub_elements.name: Update Schedule or Frequency Indicated
sub_elements.evidence: updates: 'Beta releases on quarterly basis ... through end of project in November 2026'; distribution_formats:5 'Quarterly updates through November 2026'
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear quarterly update cadence and end-of-project date

sub_elements.name: Versioned Documentation or External References
sub_elements.evidence: Version-specific resolvable DOIs per release; external_resources link to Dataverse and publications
sub_elements.quality_note: Each version has a distinct citable DOI/landing page

elements.name: Scientific Motivation and Funding Transparency

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objective or Task
sub_elements.evidence: tasks (5 entries) and intended_uses (7 entries) specifying MuSIC integration, visible neural network development, genotype-phenotype mapping, integrative structure modeling
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific research objectives and ML tasks stated

sub_elements.name: Funding Source or Grant Agency Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders: 'National Institutes of Health Common Fund Bridge2AI Program ... administered by NIH Office of the Director'; additional Frederick Thomas Fund (UVA)
sub_elements.quality_note: Funding agency clearly identified

sub_elements.name: Award Number or Grant ID Present
sub_elements.evidence: 'NIH grant 1OT2OD032742-01 (Bridge2AI Functional Genomics) and 5U54HG012513-02 (Bridge2AI Bridge Center); Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific award numbers and opportunity number provided, plus FY2025 budget figures

sub_elements.name: Acknowledgement of Platform or Participant Support

sub_elements.quality_note: Supplemental funding and platform/collaborator support acknowledged

elements.name: Technical Transparency (Data Collection and Processing)

sub_elements.evidence: collection_mechanisms name 'Generated by Lundberg Lab at Stanford University', 'Performed in Krogan Laboratory at UCSF'; maintainers list consortium institutions
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific labs and institutions identified for each modality

sub_elements.name: Data Capture Method or Device Listed
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: confocal microscopy (DAPI/calreticulin/tubulin/target channels), AP-MS and SEC-MS mass spectrometry, 10x Genomics 3'HT scRNA-seq kit; pipetting robot for fixation

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing or Cleaning Steps Documented
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies (6 entries: embedding generation, hierarchical community detection, annotation, imaging/MS QC, integrative structure modeling) and cleaning_strategies (FAIRSCAPE packaging, standard mapping)
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed preprocessing and cleaning pipeline documented

sub_elements.name: Open-Source Processing Code Provided
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: FAIRSCAPE (https://fairscape.github.io), Integrative Modeling Platform (http://integrativemodeling.org); Cytoscape, node2vec, MuSIC referenced
sub_elements.quality_note: Open-source tool repositories/documentation linked

sub_elements.name: External Standards or References Cited

sub_elements.evidence: No conflicts-of-interest statement present in the datasheet
sub_elements.quality_note: COI declaration missing

elements.name: Cross-Platform and Community Integration
elements.description: Does the dataset connect to wider data ecosystems, repositories, or standards?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Published on a Recognized Platform
sub_elements.evidence: publisher: University of California San Diego; distribution across UVA Dataverse/LibraData (NIH-approved generalist repo), MassIVE, NCBI SRA, NDEx
sub_elements.quality_note: Published on multiple recognized, community-standard platforms

sub_elements.name: Cross-referenced DOIs or Related Dataset Links
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources include Nature DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3, bioRxiv DOIs 10.1101/2024.05.21.589311 and 10.1101/2024.11.03.621734 (PMC11580897), and four release DOIs
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple cross-referenced publication and dataset DOIs

sub_elements.name: Community Standards or Schema Reference
sub_elements.evidence: conforms_to core schema; mappings to GO, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, Schema.org, EVI Evidence Graph Ontology, NCI Thesaurus, Cell Ontology, CHEBI, EFO
sub_elements.quality_note: Broad conformance to community ontologies and metadata standards

sub_elements.name: Associated Outreach Materials
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: FAIRSCAPE documentation/tutorial/installation; discouraged_uses:3 references CM4AI Skills and Workforce Development training resources; project website/portal
sub_elements.quality_note: Documentation, tutorials, and training/workforce resources referenced

sub_elements.name: Similar Dataset Links or Thematic Grouping
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources link Bridge2AI program, NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE), and the related Perturbation Cell Atlas publication (PMC11580897)
sub_elements.quality_note: Thematic grouping within Bridge2AI and links to related datasets

strengths: Exceptional provenance and version tracking: explicit version 2.1, four dated beta releases each with a distinct resolvable DOI and specific change descriptions, and a stated quarterly cadence through November 2026

Strong reuse and interoperability: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, RO-Crate/JSON-LD packaging via FAIRSCAPE with persistent ARK identifiers, and mapping to numerous public ontologies (GO, Reactome, PDB, EVI, CHEBI, EFO)
Complete funding transparency including agency (NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI), award numbers (1OT2OD032742-01, 5U54HG012513-02), opportunity number, and FY2025 budget figures

High technical transparency: named collection labs (Lundberg/Stanford, Krogan/UCSF), specific instruments (confocal microscopy, AP-MS/SEC-MS, 10x Genomics 3'HT), and a detailed 6-step preprocessing pipeline with QC steps
Rich cross-platform integration across UVA Dataverse, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, and NDEx with cross-referenced Nature and bioRxiv DOIs
weaknesses: No enumeration of removed or masked identifiers; de-identification is asserted as inherited from commercial cell-line sourcing rather than an applied technique
No informed-consent procedure documented (upstream cell-line consent implied by ethical sourcing but not described)
No conflicts-of-interest declaration in the datasheet
File-level dimensions, array sizes, or sampling rates for distributed files are not provided (only biological structural counts)
Limitations are dispersed across discouraged_uses and sensitive_elements rather than consolidated in a dedicated limitations field
recommendations: Add an explicit list of identifiers considered and confirmed absent/removed to strengthen the privacy safeguards section, even where largely N/A for cell lines
Document upstream informed-consent basis for the source cell lines (ATCC/HipSci consent provenance) in the collection process
Include a conflicts-of-interest statement covering consortium investigators and commercial licensing arrangements
Provide file-level technical characteristics (image array dimensions, MS output formats/sizes, sequencing read counts) to aid programmatic reuse
Consolidate limitations into a single dedicated section summarizing release-completeness, representativeness, and use constraints
